authorization: Root-authorized bounded failure-case diagnostic after the primary quality screen. Assess whether excluding all inadequate nulls would hide sensitivity to real frequency changes.

configuration.selection_rationale: Fixed main absorption complex based on full unshifted raw profiles; weak 1611 included from outset to constrain saturated gas. Separate absorption around −157 (2382) and −170/+133 (1611) outside common window; identities not established. Left boundary wing sensitivity retained as limitation. All source-valid pixels retained, no residual-based masks; model adequacy judged before offsets.
pre_fit_limitations: Weak 1611 overlaps a conservative strong-sky proxy near 5897 Å; no exposure-specific sky correction verified.
The common window isolates the main complex only; a nearby blue 2382 feature has unknown identity and possible wings.
Both reference 2374 and strong 2382 contain saturated pixels; weak 1611 is included from the outset to constrain columns.
Selection after profile inspection is exploratory; no anomalous shift or fitted residual was used.

sequence: One H1 from best saved primary H0; max600 evaluations.
One H0 cross-start from that H1; max500 evaluations.
Only if H0 improves by more than0.01 in chi2: one H1 cross-start from improved H0, max500 evaluations.
predeclared_interpretation: Report shifts, model adequacy, active bounds, first-order diagnostics and the objective improvement even if failed. Initial gate was a quality screen, not a population null test. No discovery significance, precision displacement, alpha estimate or cosmic-time point. Primary remains gated out regardless of delta.
